transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me a little bit about what brings you in to see me today?

I guess... I'm here about my house. Everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just paperwork, like it's just about missed payments. But... I know what's really going on. 

The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out. They keep trying to show me all these papers, but it doesn't change what I've been seeing. It's been almost two years of this.
Have you experienced any significant periods where your mood felt unusually high, energetic, or conversely, very low and hopeless, alongside these thoughts about the bank?
No. I don't... I don't really have that. My mood is just normal, I guess. I'm not depressed or... whatever else you said. I'm just trying to deal with my house.
Do you ever hear any voices or sounds that other people around you don't seem to hear?
No. I don't... hear voices. I just hear what's actually there. Like anyone else.
Aside from the situation with your house, have you ever felt that other people, organizations, or even strangers are monitoring your activities or trying to influence your life in some way?
No... not really. I mean, it's just about the house. I don't know why anyone would care about what I do otherwise. It's just... the bank and the people involved with the foreclosure. That's it.
Have you ever been shown clear evidence or had someone you trust explain that the foreclosure is strictly a standard financial process, and if so, how do you respond to that information?

They try to. My sister tried to show me some documents... and the lawyers, they just point at the numbers. But I know what's really happening. It's not just missed payments. The bank, the loan people... even some people at my store, they've been... coordinating this. To get me out. They can show me all the paperwork they want, but I've been watching this happen for almost two years. I know what I see.

Has this situation with the bank and your job caused you to have any difficulty with your daily responsibilities, such as maintaining your hygiene, household chores, or your ability to keep up with your work duties?

I do what I'm supposed to. I... get up for work. I supervise my team, handle the schedules, deal with the customers. I take care of myself just fine. 

The only time it's difficult is... well, when I get certain mail. Or if the bank calls. Or when there's paperwork at the store that... connects back to what they're doing with the house. But otherwise, no. I handle my responsibilities.
Are you open to the possibility that your interpretation of these events might be incorrect, even if only in the slightest way?

No. I'm not. 

I know why I'm here. Everyone just... keeps acting like this is normal. Like it's just paperwork. Missed payments. But I know what's happening. The bank, the loan people, the people at work... they've been working together to push me out. 

No amount of papers they show me is going to change what I've been seeing for two years. I'm not wrong about this.
